verdict.description: PASS = zero findings (empty findings array). PASS_WITH_FIXES = at least one MEDIUM or LOW finding but no BLOCKER/HIGH (consolidator auto-fixes LOWs; parent surfaces MEDIUMs for manual review but does not block advance). BLOCKS = at least one BLOCKER or HIGH that gates shipping.

verdict_reason.description: One-line rationale. Cite the single BLOCKER/HIGH driving BLOCKS, or 'no findings above LOW' for PASS_WITH_FIXES, or empty string for PASS.

autofix_class.description: Apply-authority — independent of severity. safe_auto = trivially reversible, no design call (e.g. rename an unused var). gated_auto = mechanically safe but wants human ack before applying (e.g. rename that ripples). manual = needs human implementation. advisory = surface only, no action expected.

line.description: 1-indexed line; use 0 for whole-file findings (module layout, missing header, wrong file entirely).

rationale.description: One paragraph: what breaks, why, what to verify. <=200 chars target; schema caps at 240 to allow a small overshoot without hard-reject.

unverifiable.description: true iff confirmation of this finding requires human judgment (taste, style, subjective preference) — no empirical check applies. Stage 4.5 validator uses this tag to keep-with-warning instead of drop-as-unverified.
